messages:
sam (platform): Quick heads-up — I'm scheduling a secret-path cutover from staging -> prod overlays tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need a short preflight: TF plan looks mostly clean but want someone to sanity-check KMS IAM, k8s namespace wiring, and the rollback/canary steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321

alex (infra): Are we doing a shadow deploy or full promote? My vote: shadow first, then 10% canary traffic for 20-30m, then flip. If anything fails, rollback to previous overlay. :thumbsup:

sam (platform): Shadow + canary. Plan is: 1) create prod secret path (/redwood/prod/foo) alongside staging one, 2) replication & consumer env updated to read prod path but feature-flag enabled=off, 3) canary overlay switches flag for a subset of pods, 4) monitor metrics 30m, 5) promote.

maria (sre): Quick checks I ran: KMS alias "alias/redwood-prod" exists, roles attached to infra-kms-role include kms:Decrypt for the service accounts in prod overlay. Confirmed secretsmanager policy replicated.

julie (eng): Can someone paste the TF plan snippet for the secret rename? Want to look for implicit replacement causing downtime.

sam (platform): Here — excerpt from `terraform plan`:

```
# aws_secretsmanager_secret.foo will be updated in-place
~ resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "foo" {
    name = "/redwood/staging/foo" -> "/redwood/prod/foo"
    description = "app secret"
}

# No changes to aws_iam_role.infra_kms_role
```

sam (platform): Looks like in-place update (not destroy/create) but we should still treat as risky. The provider version is pinned in the PR.

alex (infra): Important: if provider does an import/create under the hood we'll need a manual import step in preflight. I recommend running `terraform state show aws_secretsmanager_secret.foo` in staging to confirm resource_id equality, then plan in prod.

maria (sre): I ran the state check on staging — resource id matches secretsmanager arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:prod-foo-ABCD. Looks safe.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler scheduled canary window: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z (canary 10%).

julie (eng): One more ask: do we need to update the overlay namespace mapping for `realtime` service? The prod overlay currently maps `realtime` -> `realtime-prod` but the PR changes secret paths used by that service.

alex (infra): Good catch — check `overlays/prod/realtime/kustomization.yaml` for secret refs. If there's a literal path, update to the new `/redwood/prod/foo` and ensure `kustomize` patch doesn't accidentally create duplicate Secret objects.

sam (platform): I'll add a preflight checklist in the PR description:
- [ ] run `terraform plan` in prod-account (with plan file)
- [ ] confirm `terraform state` mapping for secret
- [ ] verify KMS role has kms:Decrypt for prod service accounts (maria)
- [ ] verify overlay `kustomization` patches reference new path (alex)
- [ ] schedule canary window and alerting (sam)
- [ ] reviewer signoff (julie/maria)

maria (sre): I can +1 after I confirm CloudWatch alarms for `realtime` latency and error-rate are wired to the pager during canary.

julie (eng): I'll do a quick patch review now. If no surprises, we can merge by EOD and run the preflight tomorrow morning.

sam (platform): Awesome — tagging @maria and @alex in the PR. Thanks all.

alex (infra): small note: if we need to rollback quickly, plan is to revert overlay changes (kustomize) and reapply; secrets remain intact. Keep the tf state untouched.

julie (eng): acked.

sam (platform): merging plan: PR merged -> infra pipeline runs -> manual canary start (deploy-bot) -> monitor -> promote. I'll post a short runbook link in the PR.

deploy-bot: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/secret-cutover-runbook (scheduled)

sam (platform): thanks everyone. I'll post a final checklist comment when preflight is done. :white_check_mark:
